meta.name: financial-reporting-and-close
meta.description: Runs the period-end close and produces reporting — close calendar, reconciliations, accruals, variance analysis, and reporting that gets read. Use this to shorten or stabilise a monthly close, design a close checklist, investigate a variance, structure management reporting, or work out why the numbers keep changing after close.

copy.tagline: 缩短月度结账周期,报告清晰易读
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每月结账常延期,或总在结账后才发现数字变动。
copy.tagline_en: Shorten month-end close and deliver readable reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your monthly close is often delayed or numbers change after closing.

howto.what: Claude会像管生产线一样管月度结账：排出任务顺序和负责人，定硬性截止日，把不依赖月末的工作提前做；每张资产负债表科目要有调节差异说明，应计项目要写明估算依据，报告先讲两三个关键变化及原因。
howto.when: 当你提出缩短或稳定月度结账、设计结账检查清单、调查差异等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我排一份本月结账日历，标出关键路径和各步负责人。
say.note: Claude会按依赖关系排出结账任务

say.text: 这笔挂了三期的调节项到底怎么回事？
say.note: Claude会要求说明差异及清账计划

say.text: 上月销售低于预算10%，写份差异分析。
say.note: Claude会先比基准，再分清时机还是运行率

howto.what_en: Claude manages the close as a process: task maps with owners, hard cutoff, work moved earlier, reconciliations that explain differences, documented accrual bases, reports leading with key changes and stating variance baselines.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, or investigate a variance.

say_en.text: Help me build this month's close calendar with critical path and owners.
say_en.note: Claude will map dependencies and owners.

say_en.text: What is this reconciling item that has been open for three periods?
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the difference and the plan to clear it.

say_en.text: Sales were 10% below budget last month; write a variance analysis.
say_en.note: Claude will compare against baseline and separate timing from run-rate.
